title: Letter: Be cautious, but keep AI development moving
summary: U.S. Sen. Bernie Sanders wants Washington to hit the brakes on advanced artificial intelligence, warning of lost jobs and potentially catastrophic consequences. His concerns deserve debate. However, imagine if government had stopped development of the automobile because the Model T lacked seat belts, airbags or today’s safety technology. We developed automobiles — and improved safety along the way.
